text:
maya: heads-up — main is red after merge of PR #4321 (tess). integration-gpu-e2e failing on a single test. CI: https://ci.redwood.com/build/98765. Can someone ping the owner?

ci-bot: Build failure detected on main. Job: integration-gpu-e2e (98765). Failed step: run-tests. Log excerpt:
```
ERROR: AssertionError: cache eviction mismatch
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory
```

oliver: on it, retriggering job now (rerun 98765) :hourglass:

ranjit: if rerun flakes, we should bisect. suspect PR 4321 touched KV cache timing/batching.

infra-oncall: watching. If rerun fails, marking main as blocked and pausing merges.

sophie: fyi I saw a similar transient last week on master-gpu; might be related to the batching window change. cc @oliver

oliver: rerun finished — still failing. starting bisect between main~1 and main~4. tagging @tess (PR author).

tess: ack. I can help bisect and/or open a revert if it reproduces. My change modified kernel selection for small batches, not eviction logic, but will investigate.

ranjit: quick repro tip — try forcing smaller batches or limit sequence length to see if OOM goes away. e.g.:
```bash
pytest tests/integration/test_kv_cache.py::test_kv_cache_eviction -k gpu -q -x --maxfail=1
# or run with env SMALL_BATCH=1 MAX_SEQ=512
```

oliver: launching parallel jobs for bisect (commits abc123..def456). posting updates to this thread.

maya: thx. infra-oncall, please add hold label and disable auto-merge until we have a fix/revert.

infra-oncall: added label `main-blocked-by-ci` and disabled auto-merge. :no_entry:

ci-bot: rerun links: https://ci.redwood.com/build/98765/retry | bisect console: https://ci.redwood.com/bisect/5543

sophie: if you want me to repro locally on an A100 node I can do that — ping when you have the failing commit.

tess: starting local run now on the failing commit, will post logs.

oliver: found candidate commit abcdef1 that reproduces the failure in our CI. opening short revert PR now: #4330.

maya: appreciated. once revert merges let's run a canary smoke on dedicated before unblocking main.

infra-oncall: revert PR merged and canary smoke queued. keeping main blocked until smoke passes.

sophie: thanks team — keep me posted if anyone wants me to run more local repros.

maya: closing loop here — thanks for the quick triage and revert. follow-up: add a unit test for eviction edge case and an e2e with small-batch config to catch this.
